title: OC Hypercar M1b: body fidelity
lensAText: a sceptical automotive art director. Look at every render the builder cites with the Read tool and compare them with the hypercar's reference sheet named in PROJECT_OC_HYPERCAR.md, panel by panel (crop the panels with PIL): is it recognisably THIS car, honest about being a procedural model built in code, readable at phone size, clearly better than HEAD (b49f7f3) in every view the M1b row names? Take your own garage and chase-camera frames of the OC Hypercar at 390x844 and 1280x720 on dist/artifact.html, and confirm the other four cars are unchanged.
brief: OC Hypercar milestone M1b, body fidelity, as written in PROJECT_OC_HYPERCAR.md (its M1b row: every numbered item, with the notes of what is done and not done) against the reference sheet that file names. The car is a procedural model built in code; our own brand (the OC mark); no real car brands or copied designs. HEAD is b49f7f3 (origin/claude/hypercar, the whole OC Hypercar). The first M1b build was judged: the ART lens KEPT it (clearly better than HEAD in every view the earlier art review had rejected; not yet a finished match to the sheet); the CODE lens REJECTED it: two items in the brief were still undone, and the reason given for one of them did not check out (the full verdicts were lost in the machine reset). A repair was in progress: its edits are restored on disk. Check EVERY M1b item; finish the undone ones; where an item truly needs a file that belongs to another session (src/preview/car-wheel.ts: e.g. the caliper's OC mark strip), do not edit it: say so plainly and give the exact change for that session, and make sure that reason is true. Nothing tied to the removed Races or Time Trial modes. PROVE: the same renders as M1 each beside its reference crop (front, rear, side, three-quarter, wheel) into tests/out/preview/m1b/; the other four cars' body geometry hashes identical to HEAD's and their lineup pixels identical; npx tsc --noEmit (tsconfig.json and tsconfig.game.json); npm run build; node tests/dynamics.mjs; npm test -- --only=boot,render,phone; the budget table in PROJECT_OC_HYPERCAR.md section 10 (triangles high and phone).
